research_object: Global regularity or finite-time singularity of smooth 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes solutions.
must_preserve: Distinguish classical, mild, suitable weak, and Leray-Hopf solution classes.
Preserve the exact spatial domain and initial-data assumptions in every theorem.
Do not use a finite computation, physical cutoff, or numerical observation as an all-scale proof.
Label every unverified public solution declaration CLAIM_UNDER_AUDIT.
seed_direction: Seek a scale-invariant, pressure-safe depletion inequality which either yields a critical continuation bound or identifies a precise obstruction before a critical-element compactness argument.
